orientation: no rotation, flip, or axis swap; rows=Y, cols=X throughout
limitations: Render-only 2D analysis. No surface-normal geometry or CT evidence. Candidates are exploratory visual anomalies on a render for manual review, not confirmed sheet switches, 3D drift, or voxel displacement. 2D displacement is in render (JPG) pixels only. Full-render coordinates are a documented x8 mapping, not verified VC3D coordinates.

tifxyz_valid_mask.validity_rule: x, y and z all finite and none equal to -1 (no mask.tif used)
tifxyz_valid_mask.projection: centre-aligned nearest-neighbour to the working analysis raster
tifxyz_valid_mask.effect_on_scoring: none; diagnostics only in this revision

alignment_assumptions.note: Assumed, not proven. Only an exact shared integer raster scale is verified; the origin, orientation and extent correspondence between the tifxyz grid and the render has NOT been independently confirmed from dataset metadata.

render_background_mask.source: edge-connected near-black pixels from the processed render
limitations: The grayscale threshold and minimum component size are explicit run parameters, not universally calibrated values; they depend on the dataset, the render and the working resolution.
Visible black render background is NOT equivalent to tifxyz invalid surface: the two describe different things and can disagree over large areas.
